the sun lines up with *pluto*
slides.body: the sun passes pluto about once a year. astrologers read it as what's hidden coming up. let it, then decide.

slides.headline: big talk, *bigger* promises
slides.body: astrologers read it as overstatement. lovely for a pep talk. check the numbers before you agree to anything.

slides.headline: the month's *luckiest* love aspect
slides.body: warm, generous, a bit extra. a good night for the date you've been putting off.

slides.headline: last quarter in *scorpio*: let one thing go
slides.body: the clear-out moon before the eclipse new moon on feb 6. release, don't haunt.

slides.headline: sun sextiles saturn, mercury enters *pisces*
slides.body: steady saturday, dreamier sunday. mercury moves into pisces at 01:27 utc on jan 31.

slides.headline: the truth is out. be *kind* about it.
